One gzip-compressed one-page PDF with invented text and painted vector rules.
It holds two regions that must stay out of the table output: three-column
justified prose inside a painted box and a block of short axis ticks with
numeric labels. The prose band carries two full-width rules inside it, so the
candidate reaches the ruled admission branch, whose structural guards must still
refuse it; the axis ticks are shorter than the text, so they are not the
region's own.

`python3 generate.py` rewrites the file byte for byte.
